It is one of India's largest multipurpose projects.

question: शिवसागर झील का निर्माण किस नदी पर बने बाँध से हुआ है और कोयना नदी किसकी सहायक है? / Shivajisagar Lake was formed by a dam on which river and Koyna is a tributary of which river?

कोयना नदी पर, कोयना कृष्णा नदी की सहायक नदी है जो सातारा जिले के कराड में मिलती है — इसके संगम को प्रीति संगम कहा जाता है / On Koyna River, Koyna is tributary of Krishna River meeting in Karad of Satara district — confluence called Preeti Sangam

Koyna is a tributary of Krishna River meeting it at Karad in Satara district, whose confluence is called Preeti Sangam.
